narrative: Material PL1__M6DD6978 exhibits intermittent demand with a coefficient of variation of 1.79 (high-cv/intermittent). Mean daily demand is 46.7 units with 31.3% non-zero days. Lead time averages 2.62 days (CV=0.40, moderate). The recommended (r,Q) policy sets safety stock at 238 units, reorder point at 361 units, and order quantity at 629 units (EOQ-based, above MOQ=303). The optimized policy increases total annual costs by $186.48 compared to the SAP baseline, primarily due to higher safety stock requirements to meet the 95% service level target. Recommended safety lead time is 5.08 days, suggesting an INCREASE from the current SAP setting of 3.5 days.

research_insights.selected_model: Continuous-review (r,Q) policy with normal-approximation safety stock
research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand regime classified as intermittent with CV=1.79. The (r,Q) model is appropriate as it triggers replenishment based on actual stock level rather than fixed review intervals, providing tighter control over stockout risk for sporadic, high-variance demand patterns.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Moderate — demand and lead-time variability are elevated but the 238-unit safety stock adequately buffers combined uncertainty. Storage capacity (3,502 units) is not binding: safety stock + order quantity = 867 units.
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — MOQ and capacity constraints are both satisfiable; no infeasibility detected.
